summary: [[character:milo]] completes seven months of biological work at [[location:omicron2-eridani]]. He leaves automated surveying, refining, and defensive preparations in place, forwards his report to [[character:bill]] and [[location:sol]], and departs for [[location:82-eridani]] using the [[technology:surge-drive]].

introducing.name: 82 Eridani
introducing.description: A stellar system [[character:milo]] selects as his next destination from [[location:omicron2-eridani]].

updates.current_state: Departing [[location:omicron2-eridani]] for [[location:82-eridani]] after completing a biological survey and sending his report.

updates.description: Manufacturing equipment that gives [[character:bob-replicant]] virtually unlimited flexibility for building things, including more printers, robotic workers, miners and Von Neumann machines. Increasingly common but still in its infancy, the technology has been shown to place individual atoms on a substrate.
